one_month_reasoning: Window runs to the Fri Oct 30, 2026 close (Nov 1 is a Sunday). Two scheduled events: (1) Q3-2026 earnings, expected Wed Oct 21 after the close (Nasdaq/Zacks and MarketBeat 'expected'; TI has not yet posted a webcast notice, but its 2026 reports came on Wednesdays). Consensus Q3 EPS $2.42 sits just above the $2.40 guide midpoint and Q4 consensus $2.28 already embeds seasonal decline; TXN's last six earnings-day moves averaged ~9% absolute with no sign pattern (-13.3% Jul-25, +19.4% Apr-26, -3.1% Jul-26). After a +15% run in the prior month I see no directional edge. (2) The $1.52 dividend goes ex on Oct 30 (record date Oct 30 under T+1), mechanically lowering that close by ~0.5%. I therefore center at $292.3 (spot less dividend) with a log-sigma of ~13.5% (42%/3.5 = 12% widened for the earnings event) and slightly fat tails. The China anti-dumping 'ruling' is no longer treated as a window event: China committed on 2025-11-01 to terminate the probe and nothing has been published since.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E (horizon NTM EPS ~$10.5 after SLAB amortization x 25x = $263, 55%), FCF yield (~$9.4 recurring FCF/sh at 3.5% plus ~$0.9/sh remaining CHIPS = $270, 30%) and EV/EBITDA (CY28 EBITDA ~$14.7B incl. SLAB x 16x less ~$12.3B net debt at SLAB close = $244, 15%). 25x is ~21% above the 10-peer CY27 median of 20.7x, justified mainly by the GAAP-vs-adjusted EPS basis gap.

In TXN's last three upcycles EPS fell within 2-4 years of the trough (2011 -28% after 2010; 2019 -6% after 2018; 2023 -25% after 2022), i.e. 2 of 3 cycles saw a decline by the equivalent year. Weighting ~55% on consensus-like +15% and ~45% on a flat-to-down year gives ~+8-9%. Portrait Analytics flags part of 2026 auto demand as inventory refill.

bear.story: Upcycle rolls over in 2027 as auto/industrial restocking and double-ordering unwind (as in 2018-19 and H2-2022), possibly with a 2027 US recession (Kalshi ~18-19%); NTM EPS falls to ~$8.8 and the multiple compresses to ~22x. China duties are now only a truce-breakdown tail, not a scheduled trigger; leverage at ~1x EBITDA after SLAB is manageable.

base.story: Recovery continues but decelerates: CY27 EPS ~$10, CY28 ~$11, horizon NTM ~$10.5-10.8 GAAP; multiple drifts from 29x toward ~26-27x; stock roughly flat ex a ~2% dividend, consistent with TXN's post-2003 base rate after >45% trailing years (median -1%, 47% positive, n=38 months).

bull.story: Shortage-driven pricing, data-center power and 300mm cost advantage push GM toward 2022 peak (~70%); CY28 EPS beats the $11.6 consensus (~$12.5 NTM) and the market holds ~30x, as in 2017-18 and 2021.

comps_summary.peer_range: One basis: price at 2026-10-02 close / calendar-2027 consensus EPS from one feed (Yahoo/LSEG) for all 10 peers; off-calendar fiscal years time-weighted (ADI FY Oct x1.025, MCHP and ROHM 0.25 x FY Mar-27 + 0.75 x FY Mar-28) except IFX, which uses FY Sep-27 unextrapolated (an upper-bound P/E). CY27 P/E 12.6x (Renesas) to 41.3x (MPWR), median 20.7x; core-7 broad-line (ADI, MCHP, NXPI, ON, STM, IFX, Renesas) median 18.7x on this feed vs 21.0x on the supervisor's Zacks basis. Forward EV/EBITDA is derived (TTM EBITDA + incremental pre-tax earnings), 9.0x (STM) to 33.5x (MPWR), median 12.3x; ROHM's is TTM because impairment-hit GAAP EPS breaks the derivation. stockanalysis 'Forward PE' not used. Feed caveat: Yahoo and Zacks differ by 10-20% for MCHP, NXPI, IFX and Renesas, so the median carries roughly +/-1.5x uncertainty.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: TXN trades at 29.1x CY27 ($10.10) and ~20.7x derived EV/EBITDA: ~41% and ~68% above the peer medians. I apply 25x P/E (+21% vs 20.7x median, = ADI, inside the range) and 16x EV/EBITDA (+30% vs 12.3x, below ADI 17.9x, inside the range).
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: Two persistent, evidenced factors, and no growth argument. (1) EPS basis: TXN reports GAAP only with negligible acquisition amortization, while peers' consensus EPS is adjusted. On Yahoo TTM data GAAP/adjusted EPS is ADI 0.75, NXPI 0.89, Renesas 0.86, ON 0.57, IFX 0.56, MCHP 0.32. Amortization of acquired intangibles runs on multi-year schedules, so the gap persists through the horizon. Applying even the mildest ratio (~0.87) lifts the peer median to ~24x, and ADI on GAAP is ~30x. So 25x on TXN's GAAP EPS is roughly at a like-for-like median, not a true premium. SLAB adds some amortization from 2027, which I deduct from TXN's EPS. (2) Capex is now below depreciation (H1-26 capex $1.19B vs D&A $1.09B for the half, falling capex through 2028) and $2.16B of CHIPS receipts remain, so FCF exceeds net income through the horizon. Against a larger premium: TXN's CY27 EPS growth (+19%) is the lowest in the set, its cyclicality matches peers, and its multiple compressed late in prior upcycles (16x in 2018). So I do not grant the current 29x. Sell-side outperformance calls are not used.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$205 TXN would trade at ~20x the $10.10 CY27 consensus, at or below the 20.7x peer median with the GAAP-basis premium gone, or ~23x a cut ~$8.8 EPS. The market would be pricing the upcycle as over: a double-ordering or destocking unwind in auto/industrial, a 2027 recession, or a break in the US-China truce reviving analog duties. That is ~30% below spot, about one 12-month sigma on a drift path, and below the pre-April-2026 breakout area, so it would more likely signal fundamental damage than noise. I keep $205 rather than the supervisor's $210 because my peer median is slightly lower on the single LSEG feed.

reasoning: Base rates (own computation, TXN monthly 1990-2025): unconditional 12m return median +17% (p10 -25%, p90 +71%, n=406 months). After a trailing gain >45% (TXN is +63%): median +12%, 57% positive, p10 -30%, p90 +66%, n=93 overlapping months in 19 distinct years, so effectively ~19 independent episodes. Post-2003 only: median -1%, 47% positive (n=38 months). ADI: median +12%, 66% positive (n=83, 17 years). This anchors a median near spot, not a continuation of the run. Fundamentals: CY27 consensus $10.10 (supervisor-confirmed) puts TXN at 29.1x vs a 10-peer single-feed CY27 median of 20.7x (core 18.7x; supervisor's Zacks core 21x). I re-sourced the three peer figures the supervisor could not reproduce. MCHP $4.35 and Renesas JPY283 reproduce exactly from LSEG via Yahoo (non-GAAP basis; the Zacks/MarketScreener gaps are feed or GAAP differences). IFX now uses FY Sep-27 EUR2.85 without my earlier x1.05 uplift (22.7x). I dropped ALGM, POWI and DIOD and added ROHM and Melexis. A new piece of evidence, peers' GAAP/adjusted EPS ratios, shows that 25x on TXN's GAAP EPS is close to a like-for-like peer median. Fair value $262 (was $268): P/E $263, FCF $270 (adds remaining CHIPS), EV/EBITDA $244 (net debt fixed to ~$12.3B with SLAB EBITDA, multiple cut to 16x). The CY28 haircut to $11.0 (+9%) is now explicit, ~5% below a thin consensus and grounded in TXN's cycle history. Ladder: the median is ~$285 (-3%, ~-1% after the dividend), between fair value $262 and spot, because estimate revisions are still rising (22-24 up in 30 days) and the base rate is roughly flat. Width ~37% below and ~34.5% above the median (realized 1y vol 42%, 3m 33%), with fat tails. The left tail is slightly thinner than in round 1 because the China AD probe is a truce-breakdown tail, not a dated ruling, and leverage at close is ~1x EBITDA. Research was limited to ~4 new web queries plus feed pulls; no option data used.
